en.content:
Design the intended camera work (camera movement) in Blender first, then generate the footage in Seedance 2.5 so that it reflects that camera motion.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Introducing Higgsfield in Blender.

> Prompt the scene and build the blockout
> Describe the camera move and get it animated
> Adjust anything by hand
> Reblock the whole shot in seconds

Now available via Higgsfield MCP or Supercomputer. https://t.co/TWGEwn4YGv
